thumb 400px]]A Hell-born spirit infects the Mirror Throne (16.16); it was summoned when the throne was used as a sorcerous foci.

When the Bell of Six Answers in Castle Brucoloc (08.21) is tolled, it will apparently summon an Imp from Hell.

May be related to fiends.

The Forest of Abominations releases dust from a dying universe, including decaying hells.
